docs.title: Welcome to my portfolio website
docs.text: Hello, my name is Piotr Mazur, and this is a page dedicated to my projects. They cover topics related to data analysis, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. Currently, there are a few projects, but I am constantly working on new ones. I encourage you to take a look at them – I hope everyone will find something interesting for themselves.

docs.title: Half marathon time predictor
docs.text:
This is the application for estimating runner's half marathon time. The prediction model was created with the data from 2023 and 2024 Wroclaws' half marathons using pycaret library. The app is wrapped in Streamlit and running on Digital Ocean cloud. It is also integrated with Langfuse to monitor the effectiveness of the LLM, which collects data from the user.

Go to the app

docs.title: Image Finder - an application using OpenAI models
docs.text:
Image Finder is my first application created using the Streamlit library in Python. For this project, I used OpenAI models: "text-embedding-3-large" and "gpt-4o," as well as the vector database Qdrant.

Go to the app

docs.title: EDA Data Analysis of Iris Flowers: Domain Exploration
docs.text:
I invite you to explore my analysis of the popular iris dataset using exploratory data analysis (EDA). In this project, you will find plenty of insightful conclusions and interesting observations that shed new light on these beautiful flowers.

Download the Notebook

docs.title: Titanic
docs.text:
Titanic data analysis EDA: exploration and creation of a simple predictive model I invite you to review my analysis of the popular Titanic disaster dataset through domain exploration (EDA) and the creation of a simple predictive model for passenger survival.

Download the Notebook

docs.title: Video/Audio summary
docs.text:
Video/Audio summary - an application for generating short text summaries of audio and video files Video/Audio Summary is an application that allows transcription and generation of summaries for audio and video files. It uses OpenAI models "whisper-1" and "gpt-4o-mini" for this purpose.

Go to the app
